raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add auto-label rules for the new `batch-invariance` label, so that all batch-invariance and determinism work can be found with one filter. 

## Claims

- **PRs (mergify):** a PR gets the label if it changes a file whose path contains `batch_invariant`, `batch-invariant` or `determinism`. It also gets the label if its title names batch invariance or determinism.
- **Issues (keyword workflow):** an issue gets the label if its title names batch invariance or determinism. Bodies are not checked.
- **Title patterns:**
  - batch- or TP-invariance
  - an uppercase `BI` tag
  - determinism, non-deterministic, not reproducible or run-to-run
  - batch-dependent
  - "identical / same / repeated runs, requests or calls"
- **Bare "deterministic":** PRs only. Issue titles use it for crashes that always reproduce, such as "deterministic illegal address".

## Validation

I ran both rules against every open item on 2026-11-02: 2,758 issues and 7,045 PRs, with their file lists.
- **Mergify:** I copied the regexes out of the edited `mergify.yml` and ran them with Python `re`.
- **Issue workflow:** I ran the real `github-script` code from the edited workflow in Node, with stubbed `context`/`github` objects.

| | Matched | False positives | Related but missed |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Open PRs | 106 | 10 | 10 |
| Open issues | 41 | 3 | 14 |

- **How I checked for misses:** I compared the matches against 13 GitHub searches (these also search comments) and read every result the rules did not catch.
- **PR false positives:** large formatting or lint PRs that happen to touch the batch-invariance files, plus "deterministic suffix mapping" and "batch size dependency" in the title.
- **Missed issues:** they mention batch invariance only in the body.
- **Backfill:** I already applied the label by hand to the 158 related open items (`is:open label:batch-invariance`).

`pre-commit run --files .github/mergify.yml .github/workflows/issue_autolabel.yml` passes, including actionlint and "Check auto-label rules still match real files".


---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>

files.patch:
@@ -622,6 +622,24 @@ pull_request_rules:
       add:
         - tool-calling
 
+- name: label-batch-invariance
+  description: Automatically apply batch-invariance label
+  conditions:
+    - label != stale
+    - or:
+      - files~=batch[-_]invarian
+      - files~=determinism
+      - title~=(?i)(?:batch|TP)[\s_-]?invarian
+      - title~=\bBI\b
+      - title~=(?i)determinis(?:m|tic)
+      - title~=(?i)\bnon-?reproducible\b|\bnot reproducible\b|\brun-to-run\b
+      - title~=(?i)\bbatch[\s-]?(?:size[\s-]?)?dependen
+      - title~=(?i)\b(?:identical|repeated|same)\s+(?:greedy\s+)?(?:runs?|requests?|calls?)\b
+  actions:
+    label:
+      add:
+        - batch-invariance
+
 - name: auto-rebase to keep merge candidate within 1 day behind main
   conditions:
     - base = main

@@ -394,6 +394,23 @@ jobs:
               scheduler: {
                 keywords: [{ term: "scheduler", searchIn: "title" }],
               },
+              // Title-only: bodies often use VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 as a test
+              // control, and backend-selection logs print `use_batch_invariant`.
+              // Bare "deterministic" is left out: issues use it for crashes that
+              // always reproduce.
+              "batch-invariance": {
+                regexPatterns: [
+                  { pattern: "(?:batch|TP)[\\s_-]?invarian", searchIn: "title" },
+                  { pattern: "\\bBI\\b", flags: "g", searchIn: "title" },
+                  { pattern: "\\b(?:non-?)?determinism\\b|\\bnon-?deterministic", searchIn: "title" },
+                  { pattern: "\\bnon-?reproducible\\b|\\bnot reproducible\\b|\\brun-to-run\\b", searchIn: "title" },
+                  { pattern: "\\bbatch[\\s-]?(?:size[\\s-]?)?dependen", searchIn: "title" },
+                  {
+                    pattern: "\\b(?:identical|repeated|same)\\s+(?:greedy\\s+)?(?:runs?|requests?|calls?)\\b",
+                    searchIn: "title",
+                  },
+                ],
+              },
               "kv-cache-manager": {
                 substrings: [
                   { term: "kv cache manager", searchIn: "title" },
